paragraphs: A hands-on benchmark of Jackrong/Qwopus3.6-35B-A3B-v1-GGUF at the Q5KM quant, self-hosted on a single RTX 5090 via llama.cpp. The same 17-prompt suite as the Qwopus3.6-27B v1-preview eval, for direct comparison against the dense 27B preview.

Headline: the web-design outputs are some of the best one-shot HTML I've seen out of any open model in this size class — verbose in a good way, the pages feel complete on the first attempt where most models in this class land surface-level. The MoE speedup is a massive practical win on a single 5090.

The 3 canvas prompts that didn't ship one-shot (Mandelbulb shader, soft-body physics sandbox, audio-reactive visualizer) are common failure modes for any open model in this size class — shader compile bugs, collision-math drift, AudioContext gating. They typically need a second turn to fix. They're called out honestly in the report and excluded from the headline numbers.
features: 14 of 17 runs ship cleanly — 5 agentic + 1 nothink rerun, all 5 designs, 3 of 6 creative-canvas
161.9 tok/s average, 154.4 – 164.8 range — 2.6× the dense 27B preview
106.7 k completion tokens in 11.1 minutes of generation
25 GB VRAM at 65K context with q80 KV cache on a 5090
35B total / 3B active per token — hybrid Gated-DeltaNet MoE
